changes.title: Session Encounters: who you keep meeting in battle

previous.changeLog:
VERSION CHANGES

Reset is cancelled with an error message if the backup cannot be saved
Backup is made from the current in-memory history, so recent encounters are included, and verified after writing
Reset confirmation states that history for all accounts on this PC is deleted
Statistics window explains history limits: per-battle log since 0.6.0, latest 1,500 entries, All time totals vs battles with results
Last battle tab: period and battle filters are disabled and the cards show All time
Result polling retries after temporary unavailability, handles cooldown, non-player and disconnected errors separately, cancels pending callbacks on unload and rechecks the current account when a callback runs
Players with zero damage now show 0 instead of a dash

current.changeLog:
The Battles and Your record cards now keep up to the latest 3,000 completed battle records (all accounts together), and the window explains this limit next to the All time player totals
Installation guide file names match the archive

previous.changeLog:
New animation: upon entering the hangar, Erika waves at the player (I’ll fix the issues with her hands within a day or two).
Новая анимация: при входе в ангар Эрика машет игроку (проблемы с её кистями рук я исправлю в течение дня-двух).

current.changeLog:
A new stand has been added for the main model, and its color palette has been updated—giving it a more attractive, high-quality appearance. A gradual fade-out effect has been implemented for when the camera approaches the model, an orange outline has been added, various bugs have been fixed, and shaders have been incorporated.
Для основной модели добавлена ​​новая подставка, а её цветовая палитра обновлена ​​— теперь она выглядит более привлекательно и качественно. Реализован эффект плавного исчезновения при приближении камеры к модели, добавлен оранжевый контур, исправлены различные ошибки, а также внедрены шейдеры.
